blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Дважды-Венчанный ___ (поставить / ставить) кружку и удивленно поглядел на него.
exercises.why: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). Both the imperfective and perfective forms of a Russian verb are to be memorized as a pair because there are no definite rules of forming one aspect from the other one: some twin-verbs differ only by a prefix in the perfective aspect; some have other changes: читать — прочитать, получать — получить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: The verb написать is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: Счастлив тот, чью шею ___ (обнимать) эти стройные золотистые руки, к чьей груди прижимается эта прелестная грудь.
exercises.why: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense. The letter в is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb жить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense.

exercises.q: Никогда, никогда, ___ (казать / казаться) ему, не найдет он того, чего ищет.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Молодой месяц ___ (стоять / лежать / сидеть / висеть) над горой, цвели дикие сливы…
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Долго стояли люди в ___ (благоговейное молчание), и смотрели, и что-то шептали.
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Счастлив тот, чью шею обнимают эти стройные золотистые руки, к чьей груди ___ (прижиматься) эта прелестная грудь.
exercises.why: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "с": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "-ся" the verb встречать — встретить is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я встретил моего друга.* but: *Мы встретились на улице.* We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups. Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся": *Я боюсь вашего брата.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 66–67.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Викентий Вересаев, «Состязание».
